shots.name: twirl-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Twirl card: the Preset menu showing Whirlpool, Twist at 360°, Radius 0.6, Center X and Center Y 0.5, Shape Circle and Frame Edges Mirror, beside a strip of the preview where the dancer winds into a spiral
shots.caption: Twirl with the Whirlpool preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Twist: how far the middle turns. 3 — Radius: how large the area is. 4 — Center X: where the middle sits. 5 — Frame Edges: what fills in beyond the frame.

shots.name: distort-shared-controls
shots.alt: The Twirl effect card in Properties → Effects: Preset row, Twist 200°, Radius 0.6, Center X and Center Y 0.5, Shape Circle and Frame Edges Mirror

shots.name: wave-inspector
shots.alt: Properties, Effects with a Wave card: the Preset menu showing Flag, Wave Height 0.035, Wave Count 1.2, Sway 0, Sway Count 4 and Frame Edges Mirror, then the Motion section with Speed 0.50 and Phase 0, beside a strip of the preview with the dancer
shots.caption: Wave with the Flag preset. 1 — Preset: pick a starting point. 2 — Wave Height: how far the picture lifts. 3 — Wave Count: how many waves fit across. 4 — Frame Edges: what fills in beyond the frame. 5 — Speed: how fast the waves travel.
